production.direction_en: Tilda and Iona have turned a storage room into a clinic. Kera sets the recovered ledger beside their medicine jars.
production.music_direction_en: pre: bgm_warmth (muted: a clinic in a storage room) | post: bgm_quiet_sorrow on 'Fear takes longer.'

commands.speaker: tilda_fen
commands.text: The poison is gone. Fear takes longer.

commands.speaker: iona_mist
commands.text: We will reopen this ward after the Guild is settled.

commands.speaker: fadyme
commands.text: You have given the city a place to breathe.

commands.speaker: iona_mist
commands.text: Then keep breathing while you are in it.

commands.speaker: tilda_fen
commands.text: The captain's order you carried, Sir Knight. It does not ask for her. It asks for her blood, sealed and delivered.

commands.speaker: kera_voss
commands.text: Then someone in my Guild wrote a recipe around a person.
